name: 08731 · Forked River, NJ
findings: ZIP 08731 (Forked River) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08731 (Forked River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08731 (Forked River) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
